Validate and Prepare DoDEGASv2 Parameters

Source: R/21e2-DEGASv2Screen.R
ValidateDEGASv2Params.Rd

Internal helper that handles package installation checks, input validation, and default-value resolution for DoDEGASv2().

Usage

ValidateDEGASv2Params(
  matched_bulk,
  phenotype,
  label_type = NULL,
  phenotype_class = c("binary", "survival", "continuous"),
  top_fraction_pos = 0.2,
  sclab = NULL,
  bulk_hvg = TRUE,
  bulk_de = TRUE,
  sc_de = TRUE,
  add_genes = NULL,
  n_hvg = 250L,
  n_bulk_de = 250L,
  n_sc_de = 200L,
  padj.thresh = 0.05,
  only.pos = FALSE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25,
  n_st_classes = NULL,
  loss_type = c("cross_entropy", "log_neg", "rank_loss"),
  transfer_type = c("Wasserstein", "MMD"),
  model_save_dir = "DEGASv2_res",
  lambda1 = 1L,
  lambda2 = 3L,
  lambda3 = 3L,
  tot_seeds = 10L,
  tot_iters = 300L,
  extract_embs = FALSE,
  random_feat = FALSE,
  random_perc = 0.8,
  early_stopping = FALSE,
  ...
)

Arguments

matched_bulk, phenotype, label_type, phenotype_class

Forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

top_fraction_pos, sclab, bulk_hvg, bulk_de, sc_de, add_genes

Forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

n_hvg, n_bulk_de, n_sc_de, padj.thresh, only.pos, min.pct, logfc.threshold

Forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

n_st_classes, loss_type, transfer_type, model_save_dir

Forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

lambda1, lambda2, lambda3, tot_seeds, tot_iters

Forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

extract_embs, random_feat, random_perc, early_stopping

Forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

...

Additional dots forwarded from DoDEGASv2().

Value

A named list with elements: phenotype_class, loss_type, transfer_type, verbose, seed.
